en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a village street with single-story houses with tiled roofs and wooden fences. A large group of people, including men, women, and children in traditional rural clothing, stand along both sides of the unpaved road. At the bottom, red printed text reads "Pozdrav ze Suchdola n. Lužnicí." and smaller publisher information appears in the lower left corner.
